name: synchat
description: A messenger whose group chats sort themselves into topic lanes.
author: Arvin Arun Dcosta

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.e2e: node e2e/phase1.mjs && node e2e/phase2.mjs && node e2e/phase3.mjs && node e2e/phase4.mjs && node e2e/phase5.mjs && node e2e/phase6.mjs
